title: Hovering a name in a dashboard chart legend shows latest month and average
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. At least two technicians appear in this location's Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts (they have clocked time in the period you look at). At least two service advisors appear in this location's Billing Efficiency / Advisor Analysis chart (they have invoiced work with clocked time in the period you look at).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Billing Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months and click View details.
  3. Hover one advisor's name in the legend above the chart (any advisor in the list).
  4. Read the box that appears.
  5. Hover that advisor's last point on the chart and read its value and month.
  6. Find that advisor's row in the Advisor Analysis table and read its Billing Efficiency.
  7. Repeat the hover on a technician's name in the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization legends (any technician in each legend).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The box shows the person's name, a large percent, and below it a month and an average (e.g. the advisor's name, 120%, Aug 2026 · avg 107%).
  • The large percent and the month are the person's latest month that has a value, and they match the last point you hovered on the chart (e.g. both read 120% for Aug 2026).
  • The same box appears for names on the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization legends.
  • Write the average and the table's figure for the same person in the result comment (e.g. avg 107% against 110.96% in the table). Do not pass or fail on the average: whether it must equal the table's figure is an open question for the product owner.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 9. This readout is shown in the design only; the PRD does not describe it. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 05_Billing_Legend, 06_TechEff_Legend and 07_TechUtil_Legend (readout: name, latest month with a value, average over the range).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”
  • S9-R4: “The Billing Efficiency chart draws one billing-efficiency line per advisor.”
